name: Transaction
query:
SELECT
    t.scholarship AS "Scholarship",
    t.applicant AS "Applicant:Link/Applicant:150",
    s.scholarship_type AS "Scholarship Type:Data:130",
    t.payment_id AS "Payment ID:Data:120",
    t.paid_amount AS "Paid Amount:Currency:120",
    t.transaction_date AS "Transaction Date:Date:120"
FROM
    `tabTransaction` t
LEFT JOIN
    `tabScholarship` s ON t.scholarship = s.name
WHERE
    t.docstatus = 1
ORDER BY
    t.transaction_date DESC;
